verdict.rationale: Increase is API-first: every operation, including transfers, accounts, and cards, is driven by REST calls, backed by a published OpenAPI spec and an official CLI, so it runs headlessly by design. Sandbox exposes every feature plus Simulation APIs that fast-forward multi-hour events, which suits automated test pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guidance, documentation of the CLI's non-interactive auth and scripting behavior, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
